basic_info.description: 938 Sanchez Street | A Masterpiece of Modern Luxury in Prime Noe Valley  Completed in 2025 after a meticulous foundation-up renovation, this residence redefines sophisticated San Francisco living. Detached on three sides, the home is bathed in natural light and showcases soaring ceilings, sleek designer finishes, and a level of craftsmanship rarely seen today.  The main level features expansive, elegant living spaces with a modern fireplace and custom lighting, flowing into a sensational chef's kitchen and family room that open directly onto a sunny deck for effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining.  Upstairs, spacious bedrooms provide comfort and style, while the lower level offers flexibility with a second family/media room ideal for guests, workouts, or movie nights.  Crowning the home is a spectacular roof deck with an outdoor kitchen and sweeping city views, the ultimate spot for sunset cocktails or al-fresco dining.  Additional highlights include radiant heat, solar panels with Tesla Powerwall, one-car garage plus driveway parking, and a location just steps to 24th Street's cafes and boutiques. A true Noe Valley gem blending light, design, and modern technology in one exceptional package.
